game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Frost Peaks – Rockfall Chute, a rockfall chute: the rescue climber must handle snow leopards while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Case Choir: Convert text with upper(), lower(), and title() to match the choir's tune.
theme: Frost Peaks – Rockfall Chute: a rockfall chute
core_gameplay_loop: In Rockfall Chute, repeat each round: Convert text with upper(), lower(), and title() to match the choir's tune. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the choir value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the cliff anchor using at most 14 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: The cliff anchor reached with actions_used <= 14.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 14 before the cliff anchor is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 1 (intro tier): Case Choir
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Case Choir' (Week 8 slot 3), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Rockfall Chute'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how choir changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against snow leopards in Rockfall Chute.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The cliff anchor reached with actions_used <= 14.
